name: Astrology
project_description:
This module creates a default astrology named Zodiac , which consists 12 astrological signs, namely Aries, Taurus, Gemini, Cancer, Leo, Virgo, Libra, Scorpio, Sagittarius, Capricorn, Aquarius and Pisces.

 In order to use this module functionality, site administrator needs to add text for each sign and for each format.

 It also creates a block to display astrological signs & data, named "Astrology".

 Default format can be selected from the settings page.

 New astrology can be added if the default (Zodiac) doesn't fit to the requirement, from Add astrology page.

 Default format 
 
 Day

 There is pre-installed information for each sign belonging to zodiac astrology. 
 Default format is 'day, zodiac', while this can be changed from

 "Site wide settings". 
 Provides astrological data for day, week, month, and year. 
 Users can find their astrological star sign by providing their date of birth.
